heroHeadline: RSF Kills 27 Civilians West of Barah on Eid al-Adha — North Kordofan Atrocity as SAF Counteroffensive Grinds Forward
heroSubtitle: On Day 1140, RSF-affiliated forces attacked villages in the al-Murrah area west of Barah, North Kordofan, on the second day of Eid al-Adha, killing at least 27 civilians including elderly residents. The Sudan Doctors Network confirmed the villages had no military presence. The holiday attack mirrors prior RSF patterns of targeting civilian populations during religious observances in contested Kordofan territory. SAF's sustained counteroffensive in North and South Kordofan continues — recent advances include the Dibebad crossroads (May 22–23), the third relief of Dilling (May 19–20), and the capture of Wadi al-Atrun (May 19) cutting an RSF trans-Saharan supply corridor. In West Darfur, satellite imagery continues to confirm the destruction of Misterei (May 28) as one of seven RSF-burned towns since April 2026, while Chad's border closure following the May 25 Al-Tina market strike remains in effect. With 14 million displaced, 19.5 million acutely food insecure, and active IPC Phase 5 famine zones in El Fasher and Kadugli, Sudan's humanitarian catastrophe deepens heading into the June–August lean season.
